name: Nether Rift
disable: DC 18 Arcana check, DC 18 Nature check, DC 18 Occultism check, or DC 18 Religion check (trained) to seal the rift, three successes total; or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 17)
reset: The rift reopens after 2d10 years. Killing the Path River Peeler permanently seals the rift.
routine:
(2 actions) The hazard uses its first action to repeat its Wind from the Netherworld reaction. If any patch of barrow claw remains, one of the patches chosen by the GM releases a cloud of spores. The spores fill the barrow claw's space and last until the beginning of the hazard's next turn. Creatures within the spores become Concealed, and all creature outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it.
A creature that enters the spores or starts their turn in the area takes 1d6 persistent,cold damage until they brush off the spores as an Interact action.

items.name: Wind from the Netherworld
items.text:
Trigger The Path River Peeler enters the cave

---
Effect A gust of ice-cold wind from the Netherworld blasts from the rift in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area take 2d4 cold damage (DC 20 basic Fortitude save save). The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: A chill wind blows from a fissure in the cavern wall.
